_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Qiegħed tilgħab Golf (Logħba tal-Karti) - Player {player_id}.
Għan: Ikollok l-inqas punti totali f'dan il-dawra waħda. Jekk il-kolonni jinqasmu l-istess valur, huma jiġu somati bħala 0.
Valuri tal-Karti: A=1, 2-10=valur ċar, J/Q=10, K=0

Azzjoni (uża brakketti eżatti):
- '[draw]' - Ritolja mill-deck
- '[take]' - Ħad mill-pila tal-iskart
- '[swap X Y]' - Ibdel il-karta ritolta ma' pożizzjoni X (riga) Y (kolonna)
- '[discard]' - Telaq il-karta ritolta

board.drew:
Ritolt: {card}
Issa trid [swap X Y] jew [discard]
board.took:
Ħadt: {card} mill-pila tal-iskart
Trid [swap X Y] miegħu (ma tistax telaq)

options.final_turns: Dawn l-aħħar dawriet! Għazliet tiegħek: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Għandek: [swap X Y] (ma tistax tirrifjuta karti mill-pil ta 'skart)

message.deck_empty: Il-gverta hija vojta! Logħba tispiċċa immedjatament.
message.knocked: Il-plejer {pid} jitklikkjat! Kull plejer ieħor ikollu turna oħra.
message.final_round: Player {pid} {reason}! Each other player gets one more turn.

invalid.wrong_action: Uża eżattament WAĦDA mill-azzjoni bil-brakketti: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], jew [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Il- munzell tal- skart huwa vojt!
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Ma tistax tirrifjuta karta li tkun ħadt mill- munzell tar- rifjut. Għandek taqlebha.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Għandek karta ritolta. Trid [swap X Y] jew [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Għandek bżonn karta li tkun ġiet imġarrba biex taqleb.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Għandek bżonn karta li tkun ġiet imġarrba biex tirrifjutaha.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Pożizzjoni barra mill-limiti. Uża riga 1-{max_row}, kolonna 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Ma tistax tnikket bil- karta li tkun ġibdet. Ikompli l- turno tiegħek qabel xejn.
invalid.already_knocked: Xi ħadd diġà knocked dan il-medda.
invalid.already_revealed: Din il- karta diġà ġiet żvelata!
